caption: psygnosis' pirate gunboat romp - turn-based-free naval chaos on the high seas, 1997 style.
about: Shipwreckers! (overboard! in europe, 1997) is psygnosis' naval action game: sail a pirate gunboat through top-down islands, broadside enemy ships, upgrade the hull and rescue the princess with a straight face. The two-player versus mode and the cartoon naval physics make it a genuine ps1 oddity worth keeping afloat.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps1 - played through duckstation, rom sourced from romsfun.
